translations.web: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
translations.bsb: If you are honest, leave one of your brothers in custody while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households.
translations.kjv: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
